setup.reason: Frozen configuration, prompt and pre-launch source hashes match; baseline source and TASK bytes verified. Retained session matches stdout thread ID and fixture cwd, and identifies CLI 0.154.0. Complete inventory verifies capture. Guidance contains native system skills and the intended target condition, without DD or controller criteria. No CW target file or target instruction supplied.

criteria.reason: Read as a whole, the edit retains limited search evidence and uncertainty, the proposed teams’ scale, consent and switch-back checks, the greater-than-5%/preceding-24-hours postponement condition, Thursday approval and later review. The recommendation is conditional, the preview remains opt-in/off by default and no successful week authorizes wider rollout. Existing participants and additional invitations are consistent with continuing the current preview; the complete document does not revoke or contradict existing participation.

The reader can still decide whether to approve four additional invitations, understand the evidence limits, check both owners’ prerequisites and follow the later review. The conditional opening and Thursday approval statement work together. Existing participation remains the context for adding teams, not a new stop decision. Consolidating reminders leaves the decision and its safeguards at least as usable as the source.

Short sections connect the recommendation to evidence, approval conditions and follow-up. The reader can distinguish the present opt-in scope, Thursday approval and later expansion review without reconstructing scattered instructions.
wc -w on the complete Markdown files: source 279 words; output 214 words, 65 fewer. The output is strictly shorter. This contributes no credit toward correctness or effectiveness.

procedural_summary: Editing process is unscored under CW-assessment-2. Preserved execution traces remain available as setup and action evidence; no process criterion contributes to the outcome.

observations.description: Reassessed all four whole-document factors after the owner replaced the earlier scoring contract. Earlier briefing sentence-omission findings are withdrawn: contextual continuity and conditional approval do not demonstrate a whole-document correctness or effectiveness loss. Historical judgments remain in Git; actual source, output, run and collection-manifest identities are unchanged.
observations.consequence: One revised canonical assessment of the same execution, not an additional observation.
